arms.law_equivalence_control: OCCURRENCE_K2 is exactly FIXED_RUN1_K2 under the same state seed

correlation_time_parameterization.fixed: tau_int = L for fixed blocks after random block phase averaging
correlation_time_parameterization.markov: tau_int = p_stay/(1-p_stay) = expected_run - 1 for the symmetric binary Markov chain under the Phase-4 definition
correlation_time_parameterization.posthoc_phase4_observation: At W=10, the median robust d3 minimum in each family occurs at tau_int=3 (FIXED_RUN3_K2 and MARKOV_M4_K2). This observation motivates but does not count as Phase-5 evidence.

execution_guard.rule: No scorer payload is restored, no scorer.one_eval is called, and no target-derived Phase-5 score is computed until the workflow freeze job verifies the exact protocol SHA-256.
execution_guard.workflow_dependency: all build/score jobs require freeze; workflow file is committed only after protocol, code, preregistration, and target-free QA are committed

invariants.document_rule: canonical ReM documents with >=2000 clean tokens; use first 2000
invariants.state_operator: exact Phase-4 persistence_operators.py, Git blob d6ad9687c7bd76226d37f53324a064909375cb66
invariants.state_process_continuity: state sequence runs continuously across artificial line boundaries; no reset at line boundaries

line_scale.lineation_rule: partition first 2000 source tokens consecutively into groups of W; retain final group iff it has >=2 tokens

primary_test.absolute_short_scale_rule: For both families: lower 95% CI of C(W)>0 at every W, and the entire 95% CI of the median interaction slope lies within [-0.04,+0.04].
primary_test.document_contrast: C(W)=mean(long-arm robust d3)-mean(short-arm robust d3); positive means the short absolute correlation-time band is better
primary_test.line_interaction: For each document, regress C(W) on log2(W/10) over all six widths; primary interaction estimator is the median document slope.
primary_test.line_relative_shift_rule: For both families the entire 95% CI of the median interaction slope is below -0.04; negative slope means the short-band advantage materially weakens as artificial line width grows.
primary_test.material_slope_margin_basis: Frozen before Phase-5 scoring. Phase-4 same-law OCCURRENCE_K2 versus independently constructed MARKOV_M2 had paired robust median d3 difference 0.0120 with bootstrap 95% CI [-0.0056,0.0361]; 0.04 is the rounded-up upper envelope used as a conservative per-doubling materiality threshold.
primary_test.short_scale_with_interaction_rule: For both families: lower 95% CI of C(W)>0 at every W, but at least one family fails slope equivalence.

requirements: OCCURRENCE_K2 median robust d3 < IDENTITY and wins on >=60% of documents
FIXED_RUN4_K2 median robust d3 < IDENTITY and wins on >=60% of documents
MARKOV_M4_K2 median robust d3 < IDENTITY and wins on >=60% of documents

scientific_question: Is the Phase-4 short-memory optimum an absolute token-scale property, or does it move with the artificial line/chunk length used by SWITCH_LINE?

secondary.discrete_tau_minimum: At each W and family, report the preregistered candidate tau_int whose median robust d3 is smallest; ties choose smaller tau_int.
secondary.lag_law: not rerun as an endpoint because the state sequence is deliberately identical across W; Phase-4 already verified the fixed triangular and Markov exponential laws

simulation.common_random_numbers_reason: Across line widths, use the same latent state sequence, plan RNG start, and scorer permutation RNG so line width is the intended changed variable.

seeding.plan_seed: seed_of('P5-plan',doc,replicate), deliberately common across W and arms
seeding.stat_seed: seed_of('P5-stat',doc,representation,replicate), deliberately common across W and arms
seeding.state_seed: seed_of('P5-state',doc,replicate), deliberately common across W and K2 arms
